name: Disable Pointer Trails
description: Disables the mouse pointer trail effect to reduce visual distraction and improve cursor tracking precision.

description_i18n.en: Disables the mouse pointer trail effect to reduce visual distraction and improve cursor tracking precision.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Mauszeiger-Nachverfolgungseffekt, um visülle Ablenkungen zu reduzieren und die Zeigergenauigkeit zu verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive l'effet de traînée du curseur pour réduire la distraction visuelle et améliorer la précision du suivi.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value MouseTrails under HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse to set a count of zero, which disables the trail animation
